problem_text:
A municipal water utility aims to devise a comprehensive water-conservation strategy to curtail total water losses from several aging distribution nodes. Initially, no conservation measures have been implemented.

The characteristics of each leak point are as follows:
* For Node 1, the leakage rate coefficient is 1.614, and the flow volume is 149.798.
* For Node 2, the leakage rate coefficient is 1.988, and the flow volume is 71.27.
* For Node 3, the leakage rate coefficient is 1.762, and the flow volume is 175.456.
* For Node 4, the leakage rate coefficient is 1.055, and the flow volume is 243.456.
* For Node 5, the leakage rate coefficient is 1.224, and the flow volume is 82.594.
* For Node 6, the leakage rate coefficient is 1.486, and the flow volume is 83.718.
* For Node 7, the leakage rate coefficient is 0.83, and the flow volume is 189.824.
* For Node 8, the leakage rate coefficient is 0.706, and the flow volume is 171.965.
* For Node 9, the leakage rate coefficient is 1.929, and the flow volume is 213.062.
* For Node 10, the leakage rate coefficient is 0.623, and the flow volume is 99.025.

To mitigate losses, several retrofit technologies are available, each characterized by a specific efficiency in reducing leakage:
* By deploying Technology1, water loss will be reduced by 41%
* By deploying Technology2, water loss will be reduced by 31%
* By deploying Technology3, water loss will be reduced by 70%
* By deploying Technology4, water loss will be reduced by 84%
* By deploying Technology5, water loss will be reduced by 28%
* By deploying Technology6, water loss will be reduced by 64%
* By deploying Technology7, water loss will be reduced by 16%
* By deploying Technology8, water loss will be reduced by 83%
* By deploying Technology9, water loss will be reduced by 36%
* By deploying Technology10, water loss will be reduced by 56%

Implementing a technology at a node incurs an incremental cost per unit of flow volume. The cost matrix for all node-technology pairings is detailed below:

| Node \ Technology | Technology1 | Technology2 | Technology3 | Technology4 | Technology5 | Technology6 | Technology7 | Technology8 | Technology9 | Technology10 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Node 1 | 76.178 | 70.94 | 122.837 | 14.599 | 67.916 | 197.654 | 127.082 | 198.13 | 94.02 | 37.706 |
| Node 2 | 18.527 | 165.453 | 47.94 | 81.026 | 153.969 | 172.025 | 31.351 | 20.362 | 190.299 | 186.079 |
| Node 3 | 175.063 | 165.825 | 12.609 | 141.821 | 31.143 | 95.512 | 14.322 | 49.712 | 112.221 | 48.722 |
| Node 4 | 109.421 | 59.145 | 101.775 | 148.685 | 36.856 | 142.763 | 13.494 | 120.771 | 136.07 | 18.262 |
| Node 5 | 42.361 | 63.963 | 159.946 | 127.413 | 20.086 | 134.404 | 11.583 | 83.843 | 61.549 | 171.896 |
| Node 6 | 135.419 | 174.214 | 13.625 | 174.808 | 133.388 | 53.922 | 82.333 | 195.556 | 28.925 | 69.937 |
| Node 7 | 174.687 | 110.997 | 45.419 | 105.124 | 97.017 | 186.006 | 14.083 | 57.005 | 110.589 | 73.378 |
| Node 8 | 84.746 | 39.831 | 75.888 | 76.863 | 128.794 | 54.879 | 195.866 | 105.238 | 164.26 | 128.901 |
| Node 9 | 176.949 | 179.176 | 164.823 | 15.599 | 115.438 | 63.237 | 38.825 | 180.463 | 134.817 | 26.681 |
| Node 10 | 82.619 | 192.515 | 126.365 | 128.85 | 53.211 | 55.669 | 39.022 | 194.402 | 182.85 | 72.564 |

The utility must decide how to assign these technologies to each node (nodes may adopt multiple technologies concurrently), and a node may also remain partially unmitigated if required. The strategic objective is to guarantee that the aggregate water losses are curtailed by at least a proportion P = 0.471 of the baseline losses, while simultaneously minimizing the total implementation expenditure.
